test_to_dict_orientations: test DataFrame.to_dict() with orient options including records, list, split, series, index, and tight
test_to_dict_timestamp_types: test DataFrame.to_dict() preserves Timestamp types across orient modes like records, series, and split
test_to_dict_custom_mapping: test DataFrame.to_dict() accepts custom mapping types like OrderedDict, defaultdict, and dict via the into parameter
test_to_dict_index_false: test DataFrame.to_dict() with index=False for split and tight orient modes excluding row index from output
test_to_dict_native_types: test DataFrame.to_dict() returns native Python types instead of numpy types for all orient modes
